Donald Trump has named Bill Pulte - a 38-year-old housing regulator and
staunch MAGA loyalist - as his acting director of national intelligence (DNI),
after [Tulsi Gabbard](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-tulsi-gabbard-resigns-
trump) announced she would be stepping down.

It's a pick that's baffling even [some
Republicans](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/03/tillis-trump-pulte-intelligence-
dni-senate.html), who point out Pulte's glaring lack of an intelligence
background. But like it or not, in a few short weeks, Pulte is set to start
his post atop America's 18 intel agencies.

Here are seven things to know about the man who is possibly the most
unqualified Trump pick ever - and how he got here.
